title: The Coupon Creator plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'post_title' parameter in…
description: The Coupon Creator plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 3.6.5 contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via the 'post_title' parameter. This flaw arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, allowing authenticated users with author-level access or higher to inject malicious scripts. Exploitation requires the 'Disable Print View' option to be enabled by an administrator, which is not the default setting.
